panels.title: CPU Steal
panels.description: Part of the CPU time that the hypervisor gave to other virtual machines. A value that stays above 5% shows that the hypervisor throttles this host. Linux only.

panels.title: CPU Pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Part of the time in which one task or more waited for CPU time. This shows CPU contention for the full system. It does not show the cause or the cgroup. Linux only.

panels.title: Run Queue and CPU Cores
panels.description: Runnable processes compared with the number of CPU cores. If the runnable processes stay above the number of cores, tasks wait for CPU time. Linux only.

panels.title: Temperature Compared With Critical Limit
panels.description: Sensor temperature as a percentage of its critical limit. A value near 100% shows a risk of thermal throttling. It is not proof that throttling occurred. Only sensors that report a critical limit are shown.
